    font-size: clamp(2rem, 8vw, 3rem);
  }

  .hero-social-proof {
    gap: var(--space-4);
  }

  .hero-proof-number {
    font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  }

  /* About */
  .about-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-8);
  }

  .about-badge {
    transform: none;
    bottom: var(--space-4);
    right: var(--space-4);
  }

  /* Grids */
  .grid-2, .grid-3, .grid-4 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .blog-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .testimonials-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .gallery-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .gallery-item.large {
    grid-column: span 2;
  }

  /* Stats */
  .stats-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .stat-item::after {
    display: none;
  }

  /* Steps */
  .steps-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  /* Forms */
  .form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  /* Footer */
  .footer-top {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-8);
  }

  .footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* CTA */
  .cta-title {
    font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
  }

  /* Buttons */
  .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .cta-buttons {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  /* WhatsApp float */
  .whatsapp-float {
    bottom: var(--space-6);
    right: var(--space-5);
  }

  .whatsapp-float-btn {
    width: 52px;
    height: 52px;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }

  /* Service cards */
  .service-badge {
    top: var(--space-4);
    right: var(--space-4);
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
  }
}

/* =============================================================
   RESPONSIVE - SMALL MOBILE (max 480px)
   ============================================================= */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .stats-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .gallery-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .gallery-item.large {
    grid-column: span 1;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
  }

  .btn-lg {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .btn-whatsapp {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }
}

/* =============================================================
   BLOG - ARCHIVE / LISTING
   ============================================================= */
.blog-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px;
  gap: var(--space-12);
  align-items: start;
}

.blog-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-8);
}

.blog-card {
  background: var(--color-white);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.blog-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.blog-card-img-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
}

.blog-card-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
}

.blog-card:hover .blog-card-img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.blog-card-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 200px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-dark), #2a1a1a);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 3rem;
}

.blog-card-category {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--space-3);
  left: var(--space-3);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary), var(--color-secondary));
  color: white;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-full);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.blog-card-body {
  padding: var(--space-6);
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.blog-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-4);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  color: var(--color-gray-500);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
}

.blog-card-title {
  font-size: var(--font-size-md);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-dark);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
  line-height: 1.4;
  flex: 1;
}

.blog-card-title a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition);
}

.blog-card-title a:hover {
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.blog-card-excerpt {
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: var(--color-gray-600);
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
}

.blog-card-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  transition: gap var(--transition);
  margin-top: auto;
}

.blog-card-link:hover {
  gap: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
}

/* Sidebar */
.sidebar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-6);
  position: sticky;
  top: 100px;
}

.sidebar-widget {
  background: var(--color-white);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-6);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

.sidebar-widget-title {
  font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-dark);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-3);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-gray-200);
}

.sidebar-cta {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-dark), #2a1a1a);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-6);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
}

.sidebar-cta p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.widget-list li {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
}

.widget-list li:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.widget-list li a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: var(--space-3) 0;
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: var(--color-gray-700);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition);
}

.widget-list li a:hover {
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.widget-list .count {
  background: var(--color-gray-100);
  color: var(--color-gray-600);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-full);
}

/* Tag */
.tag {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--color-gray-100);
  color: var(--color-gray-700);
  padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-full);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-weight: 600;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-300);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all var(--transition);
  margin: 0.2rem 0.1rem;
}

.tag:hover {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: white;
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
}

/* Pagination */
.pagination {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  margin-top: var(--space-12);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.pagination a,
.pagination span {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-3);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all var(--transition);
  background: var(--color-white);
  color: var(--color-gray-700);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-300);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.pagination a:hover,
.pagination .current {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary), var(--color-secondary));
  color: white;
  border-color: transparent;
}

/* =============================================================
   BLOG - SINGLE POST
   ============================================================= */
.post-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-darker) 0%, #2d0a0a 50%, var(--color-dark) 100%);
  padding: 4rem 0 3rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.post-header::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(192,57,43,0.25) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.post-header .container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  max-width: 860px;
}

.post-featured-img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  opacity: 0.2;
}

.post-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-4);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
}

.post-meta span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.post-category-badge {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary), var(--color-secondary));
  color: white;
  padding: 0.25rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-full);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.post-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--color-white);
  line-height: 1.15;
}

/* Post content typography */
.post-content {
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--color-gray-800);
}

.post-content p {
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.post-content h2 {
  font-size: 1.625rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--color-dark);
  margin: 2.5rem 0 1rem;
  padding-bottom: var(--space-3);
  border-bottom: 3px solid;
  border-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-primary), var(--color-secondary)) 1;
}

.post-content h3 {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-dark);
  margin: 2rem 0 0.75rem;
}

.post-content ul,
.post-content ol {
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.post-content ul {
  list-style: none;
  padding-left: 0;
}

.post-content ul li {
  padding-left: 1.75rem;
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.post-content ul li::before {
  content: '??';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.post-content ol {
  list-style: decimal;
  padding-left: 1.5rem;
}

.post-content ol li {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
  padding-left: 0.25rem;
}

.post-content strong {
  color: var(--color-dark);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.post-content blockquote {
  border-left: 4px solid var(--color-secondary);
  background: rgba(230,126,34,0.06);
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  border-radius: 0 var(--border-radius) var(--border-radius) 0;
  margin: 2rem 0;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--color-gray-700);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.post-content blockquote strong {
  color: var(--color-secondary);
}

.post-content table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: 2rem 0;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.post-content table th {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-dark), #2a1a1a);
  color: white;
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: left;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.post-content table td {
  padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
  vertical-align: top;
}

.post-content table tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.post-content table tr:nth-child(even) td {
  background: rgba(255,248,240,0.5);
}

/* Info box */
.info-box {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(192,57,43,0.06), rgba(230,126,34,0.06));
  border: 1px solid rgba(230,126,34,0.35);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
  padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
  margin: 2rem 0;
}

.info-box-title {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-secondary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
}

/* Curiosity cards grid */
.curiosity-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-5);
  margin: 2rem 0;
}

.curiosity-card {
  background: var(--color-white);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
  padding: 1.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  transition: transform var(--transition);
}

.curiosity-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.curiosity-icon {
  font-size: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
  display: block;
}

.curiosity-title {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-dark);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
}

.curiosity-text {
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: var(--color-gray-600);
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* Share buttons */
.share-buttons {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-3);
  padding: var(--space-6) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
  margin: 2rem 0;
}

.share-label {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--color-gray-600);
}

.share-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-full);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--transition);
  border: none;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.share-btn.whatsapp {
  background: var(--color-whatsapp);
  color: white;
}

.share-btn.whatsapp:hover {
  background: var(--color-whatsapp-dark);
  color: white;
}

/* Author box */
.author-box {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-6);
  background: var(--color-white);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-7);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  margin-top: var(--space-10);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
}

.author-avatar {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.author-avatar img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.author-name {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--color-dark);
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.author-role {
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: var(--color-secondary);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
}

.author-bio {
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  color: var(--color-gray-600);
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* Fire divider */
.fire-divider {
  text-align: center;
  margin: 2.5rem 0;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.5rem;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* =============================================================
   PRINT STYLES
   ============================================================= */
@media print {
  .topbar,
  .site-header,
  .hamburger,
  .mobile-nav,
  .whatsapp-float,
  .hero-scroll-indicator {
    display: none !important;
  }

  body {
    font-size: 12pt;
    color: #000;
  }

  .container {
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  a {
    color: #000;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .btn {
    border: 1px solid #000;
    background: none;
    color: #000;
  }
}

/* Preview overrides */
.about-image-placeholder {
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fdf3e7,#e9ecef);border-radius:12px;
    min-height:400px;color:#6c757d;font-size:1rem;
}
.placeholder-icon{font-size:4rem;margin-bottom:1rem;}
.blog-card-image-placeholder{width:100%;height:200px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fdf3e7,#e9ecef);
    border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:3rem;}
.fade-in,.fade-in-left,.fade-in-right{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;}
body{overflow-x:hidden;}
</style>
</head>
<body class="home page">
